"""Independent bounded Core identity/time probes; no live model or source mutation."""
import asyncio
import importlib
import json
import platform
import tempfile
import time
from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError
from datetime import UTC, date, datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, patch
from uuid import UUID
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

from devtools.agents.conversation import (
    Conversation, ConversationId, ConversationMessage, ConversationMessageRole, History, MessageId,
)
from devtools.core.identity import Identity
from devtools.core.paths import resolve_path
from devtools.core.time import Duration, Stopwatch, Timestamp, parse_timestamp
from devtools.execution import InteractionAttempt, InteractionAttemptId
from devtools.models.interaction import InteractionSource, ModelRequest, Prompt
from devtools.models.interaction.providers.llama_cpp import LlamaCppInteraction
from devtools.observability.evidence.terminal import EvidenceId, InteractionAttemptTerminalEvidence
from devtools.observability.usage.models import UsageObservation
from devtools.observability.usage.windows import UsageWindow
from devtools.models.interaction.usage import ModelUsage
from devtools.persistence import SqliteConversationStore, decode_conversation_json, encode_conversation_json

OUT = Path(__file__).parent
rows = []

def observe(name, expected, operation, classification="CONTROL"):
    try:
        actual = operation()
    except Exception as error:
        actual = {"error": type(error).__name__}
    rows.append(dict(name=name, expected=expected, observed=actual,
                     agrees=actual == expected, classification=classification))

text = "12345678-1234-5678-9234-567812345678"
observe("identity UUID string normalization", text,
        lambda: str(Identity.parse("URN:UUID:".lower() + text.upper())))
observe("identity rejects non UUID construction", {"error":"TypeError"}, lambda: Identity(text))
observe("identity all UUID versions accepted", 1,
        lambda: Identity.parse("6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8").value.version)
observe("identity same UUID equal and hash compatible", [True, True],
        lambda: [Identity.parse(text) == Identity(UUID(text)), hash(Identity.parse(text)) == hash(Identity(UUID(text)))])
observe("semantic IDs distinguish same backing UUID", [False, False, True],
        lambda: [ConversationId.parse(text) == MessageId.parse(text),
                 EvidenceId.parse(text) == InteractionAttemptId.parse(text),
                 ConversationId.parse(text) == ConversationId.parse(text)])
observe("identity has no ordering", {"error":"TypeError"}, lambda: Identity.parse(text) < Identity.parse(text))
def immutable():
    value = Identity.parse(text)
    value.value = UUID(int=0)
observe("identity immutability", {"error":"FrozenInstanceError"}, immutable)

for method, amount in [("nanoseconds",-1),("nanoseconds",-499),("seconds",-1e-12),
                       ("milliseconds",-1e-9),("minutes",-1e-12),("hours",-1e-14)]:
    observe(f"negative factory {method} {amount}", {"error":"ValueError"},
            lambda method=method, amount=amount: getattr(Duration, method)(amount).total_seconds,
            "EXISTING_DURATION_PROPOSAL")
for method in ["nanoseconds","seconds","milliseconds","minutes","hours"]:
    observe(f"zero {method}", 0.0, lambda method=method: getattr(Duration,method)(0).total_seconds)
observe("positive precision half even nanoseconds", [0,0,2,2],
        lambda:[Duration.nanoseconds(n).value.microseconds for n in (1,500,1500,2500)])
observe("positive arithmetic", [5.0,1.5], lambda:[(Duration.seconds(3)+Duration.seconds(2)).total_seconds,
                                                (Duration.seconds(3)/2).total_seconds])
observe("negative subtraction", {"error":"ValueError"}, lambda: Duration.seconds(1)-Duration.seconds(2))
observe("negative scale rounds away", {"error":"ValueError"},
        lambda:(Duration.nanoseconds(1000)*-0.1).total_seconds, "DURATION_ARITHMETIC_SCOPE_QUALIFICATION")
observe("negative divisor rounds away", {"error":"ValueError"},
        lambda:(Duration.nanoseconds(1000)/-10).total_seconds, "DURATION_ARITHMETIC_SCOPE_QUALIFICATION")
observe("NaN seconds", {"error":"ValueError"}, lambda: Duration.seconds(float('nan')))
observe("infinite seconds", {"error":"OverflowError"}, lambda: Duration.seconds(float('inf')))
observe("divide by zero", {"error":"ZeroDivisionError"}, lambda: Duration.seconds(1)/0)

observe("timestamp direct naive refusal", {"error":"ValueError"}, lambda: Timestamp(datetime(2026,1,2)))
observe("naive parse intentionally UTC", "2026-01-02T00:00:00+00:00", lambda: str(parse_timestamp(date(2026,1,2))))
observe("ISO naive intentionally UTC", "2026-01-02T03:04:05+00:00",
        lambda: str(Timestamp.from_isoformat("2026-01-02T03:04:05")))
observe("offset canonical equality and hash", [True,True],
        lambda:[Timestamp.from_isoformat("2026-01-02T08:04:05+05:00") == Timestamp.from_isoformat("2026-01-02T03:04:05Z"),
                hash(Timestamp.from_isoformat("2026-01-02T08:04:05+05:00")) == hash(Timestamp.from_isoformat("2026-01-02T03:04:05Z"))])
observe("timestamp microsecond round trip", "2026-01-02T03:04:05.123456+00:00",
        lambda:str(Timestamp.from_isoformat(str(Timestamp(datetime(2026,1,2,3,4,5,123456,tzinfo=UTC))))))
observe("invalid date", {"error":"TimestampParsingError"}, lambda: parse_timestamp("2026-02-30"))
observe("non ISO fallback deliberately separate", {"error":"TimestampParsingError"}, lambda: Timestamp.from_isoformat("01/02/2026"))
observe("DST repeated local hour distinct instants", ["2026-11-01T05:30:00+00:00","2026-11-01T06:30:00+00:00"],
        lambda:[str(Timestamp(datetime(2026,11,1,1,30,tzinfo=ZoneInfo('America/New_York'),fold=f))) for f in (0,1)])
observe("timestamp underflow retains native overflow", {"error":"OverflowError"},
        lambda: Timestamp(datetime.min.replace(tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=1)))))
observe("negative timestamp difference refused", {"error":"ValueError"},
        lambda: Timestamp.from_isoformat("2026-01-01T00:00:00Z")-Timestamp.from_isoformat("2026-01-02T00:00:00Z"))

def stopwatch_boundary():
    with patch('devtools.core.time.models.stopwatch.perf_counter_ns', side_effect=[1000000,1100000,1400000]) as clock:
        s=Stopwatch()
        running=s.elapsed.value.microseconds
        stopped=s.stop().value.microseconds
        again=s.stop().value.microseconds
        return [running,stopped,again,clock.call_count,s.is_stopped]
observe("monotonic stopwatch exact values and idempotent stop", [100,400,400,3,True], stopwatch_boundary)
def stopwatch_exception():
    with patch('devtools.core.time.models.stopwatch.perf_counter_ns',side_effect=[1000000,1100000]):
        s=Stopwatch()
        try:
            with s: raise RuntimeError('original')
        except RuntimeError as error:
            return [str(error),s.elapsed.value.microseconds,s.is_stopped]
observe("context preserves exception", ['original',100,True], stopwatch_exception)
def tiny_elapsed():
    with patch('devtools.core.time.models.stopwatch.perf_counter_ns',side_effect=[10000,10100]):
        return Stopwatch().stop().total_seconds
observe("submicrosecond elapsed rounds zero intentionally", 0.0, tiny_elapsed)

stamp=Timestamp.from_isoformat('2026-01-02T03:04:05.123456Z')
message=ConversationMessage(id=MessageId.parse(text),created_at=stamp,content='literal evidence',
                            role=ConversationMessageRole.USER,source=InteractionSource('caller'))
conversation=Conversation(id=ConversationId.parse(text),created_at=stamp,history=History(messages=(message,)))
def persistence_roundtrip():
    encoded=encode_conversation_json(conversation)
    value=json.loads(encoded)
    assert value['session']['id']==text
    assert value['session']['created_at']=='2026-01-02T03:04:05.123456+00:00'
    restored=decode_conversation_json(encoded)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-time-probe-') as folder:
        store=SqliteConversationStore(database=resolve_path(Path(folder)/'state.sqlite'))
        store.save(restored)
        saved=store.load(ConversationId.parse(text))
        return [restored.id==conversation.id,restored.created_at==stamp,
                restored.history.messages[0].id==message.id,
                saved.id==conversation.id,saved.created_at==stamp,
                saved.history.messages[0].created_at==stamp]
observe("real JSON and SQLite identity time round trip", [True]*6, persistence_roundtrip)
def foreign_identity():
    value=json.loads(encode_conversation_json(conversation));value['session']['id']='../../foreign'
    return decode_conversation_json(json.dumps(value))
observe("persistence refuses malformed identity", {"error":"PersistenceFormatError"}, foreign_identity)

def usage_roundtrip():
    u=UsageObservation(timestamp=stamp,backend='fake',provider='fixed',model='m',reasoning_effort='unknown',
                       execution_profile='probe',invocation_id=text,thread_id=None,turn_id=None,response_id=None,
                       usage=ModelUsage(input_tokens=7),source='literal',source_digest='probe-digest')
    restored=UsageObservation.from_dict(u.to_dict())
    return [restored.timestamp==stamp,restored.original_timestamp is None,restored.usage.input_tokens]
observe("usage persistence preserves time and unknown", [True,True,7], usage_roundtrip)
observe("usage window half open and missing time", [True,False,False],
        lambda:[UsageWindow(stamp,stamp+Duration.seconds(1)).contains(x)
                for x in (stamp,stamp+Duration.seconds(1),None)])
observe("DST calendar week vs elapsed week", [167.0,168.0], lambda:[
    (UsageWindow.calendar_week(Timestamp.from_isoformat('2026-03-08T12:00:00Z'),'America/New_York').end.value-
     UsageWindow.calendar_week(Timestamp.from_isoformat('2026-03-08T12:00:00Z'),'America/New_York').start.value).total_seconds()/3600,
    (UsageWindow.rolling(stamp).end.value-UsageWindow.rolling(stamp).start.value).total_seconds()/3600])

early=Timestamp.from_isoformat('2026-01-02T00:00:00Z')
late=Timestamp.from_isoformat('2026-01-02T00:00:01Z')
def lifecycle_evidence():
    with patch.object(Timestamp,'now',side_effect=[early,late,late]):
        a=InteractionAttempt.new(conversation_id=ConversationId.parse(text),message_id=MessageId.parse(text),interaction_source=InteractionSource('fake'))
        a.succeed()
        from devtools.execution import InteractionAttemptSucceeded
        e=InteractionAttemptTerminalEvidence.new(attempt_id=a.id,occurred_at=a.completed_at,outcome=InteractionAttemptSucceeded())
        return [a.started_at==early,a.completed_at==late,e.occurred_at==late,e.observed_at==late,e.attempt_id==a.id]
observe("real attempt and evidence timestamp producer", [True]*5, lifecycle_evidence)

class Observer:
    def __init__(self): self.records=[]
    def interaction_completed(self, observation): self.records.append(observation)

async def adapter_with_clock_change(observer_enabled, reverse):
    observer=Observer() if observer_enabled else None
    adapter=LlamaCppInteraction(endpoint='http://127.0.0.1:1',model='deterministic-double',source=InteractionSource('fake'),observer=observer)
    reply={'choices':[{'finish_reason':'stop','message':{'role':'assistant','content':'literal reply'}}]}
    post=AsyncMock(return_value=reply)
    clocks=[late,early] if reverse else [early,late]
    with patch('devtools.models.interaction.providers.llama_cpp._post_chat_completion',post),patch.object(Timestamp,'now',side_effect=clocks):
        try:
            response=await adapter.send(ModelRequest(prompt=Prompt('literal prompt','user')))
            outcome={'returned':response.content,'provider_entries':post.await_count,'observations':len(observer.records) if observer else 0}
        except Exception as error:
            outcome={'error':type(error).__name__,'provider_entries':post.await_count,'observations':len(observer.records) if observer else 0}
    return outcome
observe("provider adapter forward clock control", {'returned':'literal reply','provider_entries':1,'observations':1},
        lambda:asyncio.run(adapter_with_clock_change(True,False)))
observe("provider adapter backward wall clock no observer", {'returned':'literal reply','provider_entries':1,'observations':0},
        lambda:asyncio.run(adapter_with_clock_change(False,True)))
observe("provider adapter backward wall clock observed outcome", {'error':'ValueError','provider_entries':1,'observations':0},
        lambda:asyncio.run(adapter_with_clock_change(True,True)), 'DOCUMENTED_OBSERVATION_LIMITATION')

result=dict(at=str(Timestamp.now()),python=platform.python_version(),platform=platform.platform(),
            clock=dict(monotonic=time.get_clock_info('perf_counter').monotonic,resolution=time.get_clock_info('perf_counter').resolution),
            rows=rows,expected_control_mismatches=[r for r in rows if not r['agrees'] and r['classification'] not in
               {'EXISTING_DURATION_PROPOSAL','DURATION_ARITHMETIC_SCOPE_QUALIFICATION'}],
            scope='Deterministic input/clock/transport doubles plus temporary JSON/SQLite; no live models, real grants, production edits or external source mutations.')
(OUT/'probes.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(dict(cases=len(rows),reproduced_duration_boundaries=sum(not r['agrees'] for r in rows),unexpected=result['expected_control_mismatches']),indent=2))
assert not result['expected_control_mismatches'],result['expected_control_mismatches']
